props.name: entity_type
props.meaning: Type the root of every field path is read on.

props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every read goes through it, so widgets on a page share one cache.

props.name: value
props.meaning: The tree. Two-way in Svelte through `bind:value`.

props.name: hide_paths
props.meaning: Paths kept out of the field list. A pattern hides itself and everything under it.

props.name: project_id
props.meaning: Scopes the status pickers to the codes one project allows.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when a group holds no condition.

props.name: disabled
props.meaning: Dims the editor and blocks every control.

props.name: size
props.meaning: The control ladder: every control in a row stands at 28, 32 or 36, with a shadcn button of the same size.

events.name: changed
events.when: The whole tree changed, on every edit. Svelte also binds it with `bind:value`.

slots.name: entityEditor
slots.receives: The same arguments as the value editor.

keyboard.does: Moves between field, operator, value and the remove control of each row.
Opens the field chooser, the operator menu or a value popover.
Move the cursor in an open menu or list; move between All and Any.
Descends into the highlighted link in the field chooser.
Goes back one level in the field chooser.
Chooses the highlighted field, operator or value. In a multi-value list it checks the highlighted entry and the list stays open.
Closes the open menu or popover.
In an entity picker's empty search box, takes the caret to the last chip; a second press removes it.
